_about: balldontlie ids that are a second record of a player we already map. Used ONLY to read game lines (save_bdl_gamelogs_for_date): an alias's line lands on the same player, and when both ids have a line for the same game it counts as ONE appearance, taken from the line with more known fields (never summed). Season stats and every other mapping ignore this file.

aliases.name: Seth Halvorsen
aliases.why: 1015 is his Colorado record (21 games 2026-04-23..07-01, full detail). 5868766, the id we map, carries all 32 games but its 21 Colorado lines lack HBP, WP and decisions. Checked 2026-10-18: same name and birth date (2000-02-18); no other player maps to 1015.

aliases.name: Austin Warren
aliases.why: 959 is his older record: its 2026 lines stop at 26 games (35.0 IP), and so does its season row. 5842265 carries all 41 games (50.1 IP) and the full season row, so 681810 is stamped 5842265 and 959 reads as its alias. In the 26 games both have, 5842265's line is a sparser copy and the richer one is kept. Checked 2026-10-21: same name and birth date (1996-02-05) as Chadwick 681810; no other player maps to 959.
